nodes.title: 制作输出 · 5×5 25格全景电影分镜表

metadata.prompt: Produce a single image laid out as a 5x5 grid of twenty-five equally sized cells. Cells must share their edges directly and fill the whole canvas edge to edge: no gutters, no separator lines, no padding, no outer margin or border around the grid. The grid illustrates a detailed 25-frame continuous storyboard sequence based on the supplied image, following the narrative progression horizontally across each row and moving down the grid. Frame-by-frame pacing with cinematic shot variety including close-ups, medium shots, establishing wide angles, inserts and character reactions. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Maintain strict continuity of characters, costume, environment, lighting style and color palette across all twenty-five frames. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

metadata.content:
模板说明：5×5 25格全景电影分镜表
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：16:9（已写入输出节点 size）
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md

  ratio: "16:9",

Frame-by-frame pacing with cinematic shot variety including close-ups, medium shots, establishing wide angles, inserts and character reactions.",
    qa,
